rows.DESCRIPTION: MP: Observing failure in receiving L/MWD data. Attempting to reset tools and downlink, without success. Obs.: - Troubleshooting sequence: - Trying to reset tool with downlink. - Turning pumps on and off (MP 1 & 3) at 600 gpm / 2350 psi. - Trying to reset tool with downlink (2x). - Observing abrupt drop of 280 psi in column and stabilization at this level. - Testing NRVs, ok. - Closing IBOP and pressurizing with 500 psi, ok. - Turning pumps on and off (MP 1 & 3) at 650 gpm / 2300 psi (verifying 2050 psi at 600 gpm). - Turning pumps on and off (MP 2 & 3) at 650 gpm / 2300 psi. - Turning pumps on and off (MP 1 & 2) at 700 gpm / 2580 psi (verifying 2070 psi at 600 gpm). - Turning pumps on and off (MP 1 & 2) at 750 gpm / 2850 psi. - Performing manual mode switch (turning pumps on and off 2 x at 3 min interval) at 650 gpm / 2330 psi. - Turning pumps on and off (MP 1 & 2) at 800 gpm / 3000 psi. - Observing abrupt pressure increase in column to 3300 psi, reducing flow to 600 gpm and observing pressure of 2400 psi, consistent with that observed during drilling. - Turning pumps on and off (MP 1 & 3) at 600 gpm / 2400 psi. - Trying to reset tool with downlink. - Performing manual mode switch at 650 gpm / 2700 psi. - Trying to reset tool with downlink (2x). - Turning pumps on and off (MP 1 & 3) at 650 gpm / 2700 psi.

MP: Performing dynamic flow check for 15 min, OK. Pulling 1 section of DP 5 7/8" maintaining SBP 9.8 ppg at shoe + 120 psi. Breaking drilling section. Obs.: - Selecting EDS#5 (CSR+LBSR with EHBS in LBSR).
